'''Blaster suppressors''' were devices that [[Sound_suppressor|quieted]] [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] by reducing the injection of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and modifying the [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating module]]. This quieted the blaster, but also reduced its range and firepower.<ref name="Strongholds" />
